mapper.select: SELECT id, outbound_no, product_id, product_name, product_code, outbound_date, quantity, reason, remarks, reg_user_id, reg_user_name, reg_date FROM v_outbound_list WHERE id > 0 ORDER BY outbound_date DESC LIMIT #{skip}, #{amount}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbound ( outbound_no, product_id, outbound_date, quantity, reason, remarks, reg_user_id ) VALUES ( #{outBoundNo}, #{productId}, #{outboundDate}, #{quantity}, #{reason}, #{remarks}, #{regUserId} )
mapper.select: SELECT outbound_no FROM outbound WHERE outbound_no LIKE CONCAT('OUT-', #{dateStr}, '%') ORDER BY outbound_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM outbound WHERE id > 0
